annotations.title: EVE Frontier Sui zkLogin BN254 Proof & SmartCharacter Verifier

description: Verifies EVE Frontier Sui zkLogin BN254 zero-knowledge proofs, ephemeral session signatures, and SmartCharacter ownership capabilities. Use when authenticating a pilot's off-chain OAuth/zkLogin session before granting tribe vault or dApp access; for auditing tribe-wide diplomatic standings and reputation registries, use audit_eve_tribe_standings instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'jwt_proof' ('ephemeral_scheme' defaults to 'ED25519'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (25 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

ephemeral_scheme.description: Cryptographic signature scheme of the ephemeral session key; defaults to 'ED25519' when omitted.

jwt_proof.description: Encoded Sui zkLogin proof payload or JWT session token string (minimum 20 characters).

name: verify_eve_zklogin_character

character_verified.description: True when the zkLogin BN254 proof and salt derivation are valid.

sui_address_derived.description: Deterministic 32-byte Sui address derived from the zkLogin issuer and salt.

tribe_acl_eligible.description: True if the verified SmartCharacter holds active Tribe membership.
